INSERT INTO attendances (residentId, checkIn, checkOut, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  r.id,
  DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE),
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM residents r
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka';
